name: NekRS GPU Spectral Element Solver
description: Builds NekRS 26.0 (third_party/nekrs submodule) with OCCA CUDA, GPU HYPRE and GPU-aware MPI (HPC-X Open MPI with GNU compilers), plus HydroGym's nekrs-mpmd driver (examples/nekrs/mpmd) and a hydrogym[nekrs] venv with mpi4py built against the same MPI.

cudaArch.description: CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES for the ahead-of-time compiled parts (HYPRE etc). OCCA kernels are JIT-compiled for the GPU found at run time, so this is not the only GPU the build runs on. Examples: 75 (Turing), 80;86 (Ampere), 89 (Ada), 90 (Hopper).

gpuMpi.description: NEKRS_GPU_MPI: pass device buffers straight to MPI (HPC-X is CUDA-aware). Turn off on hosts where GPU peer-to-peer is broken and runs use more than one rank (or set UCX_TLS without cuda_ipc at run time instead).

cudaVersion.description: CUDA toolkit from NVHPC's cuda_multi install. 13.2 needs a driver for CUDA >= 13.0 (r580+); 12.9 for older drivers.
